verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for a consumer and API AI product like Grok, so the axis applies. The pack documents no opt-out control. The only related items are generic 'enterprise-grade privacy protections' for team workspaces and a note that prompts and responses are stored on xAI's servers, and neither is a user-facing telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
